title: Fix Cannot Remove From Team
description: Applies a workaround for the 'Cannot remove from team' that causes Minecraft to trigger an error
body:
# Fix Cannot Remove From Team 

While playing on some servers, you might encounter an error like: `Player is either on another team or not on any team. Cannot remove from team 'someteam'.

This mod suppresses that error and replaces it with a warn log so it doesn't disconnect you from the server.
